messages:
alex: Heads-up — want to align on the cutover playbook for catalog model retirements and customer migrations. My high-level proposal: a 3-step phased cutover with benchmark gates, a staged tenant opt-in, and a short pin-exception window. Thoughts?

maria: +1. We need explicit latency and correctness SLO gates per cohort. Also who owns the canary monitoring and alert runbooks?

ben: Eng can own the canary dashboards and rollback automation. Suggest auto-fallback to the previous pinned model if p95 latency regresses >20% for >10m.

sara: From CS: customers will expect a 14-day heads-up email minimum and a 30-day opt-out window for non-critical changes. Enterprise contracts often require a version-lock API option during migrations.

alex: Agreed. Drafting an artifacts checklist — please review and add anything missing:
- benchmark report (perf + quality) for new model vs pinned baseline
- rollout runbook with step-by-step ops commands
- customer comms templates (email + in-console banner)
- updated SLA language (if latency/throughput changes)
- rollback and pin-exception policy

maria: Add: canary sample size, telemetry retention, and cost estimate for canary traffic. I recommend at least 50k requests over 24h to get stable p95s.

ben: Tech config suggestion for the canary (we'll iterate):
```
canary:
  cohort: 5%
  duration: 48h
  metrics:
    - p50_latency
    - p95_latency
    - error_rate
    - top_k_token_diff (quality probe)
```
Also need a health check for KV cache correctness — include an automated smoke test.

alex: Proposed launch gates (soft + hard):
- Soft gates (to begin staged rollout): perf within 10% of baseline, eval-set quality regression <2%, no critical errors in smoke tests for 12h.
- Hard gates (blockers to GA): signed customer opt-ins for cohorts with strict SLAs, legal sign-off on SLA text changes, infra capacity confirmed for peak traffic.

sara: I'll prep the customer-facing rollback FAQ and the contact matrix (who to call at 2am). Also worth noting: some customers ask for a migration calendar and an option to schedule a personal cutover.

ops-bot: Deploy window reservation created: 2026-04-05 02:00-06:00 UTC. Please confirm availability. :calendar: 

ben: One more product ask — we should expose a temporary pin-exception API that allows customers to pin to previous model for up to 30 days post-cutover. That reduces live incidents during mass migrations.

alex: Good call. Action items and tentative owners/due dates: ben -> finish canary config & smoke tests (due 3061122400), maria -> finalize telemetry dashboards and threshold alerting (due 3061122375), sara -> draft comms + rollback FAQ (due 3061122360), alex -> consolidate runbook and SLA diff (due 3061122390). We'll do a short sync tomorrow to confirm. :thumbsup:

maria: ack

ben: ack

sara: ack
